storage_classes.name: Standard

price.note: Standard: USD 0.02/GB/month for Global and Single-region buckets ('Tigris pricing is the same across all geographies'). Tigris measures storage in binary GB (2^30 bytes).

put_per_1000.note: Class A requests (includes PutObject, CopyObject, CreateMultipartUpload) USD 0.005/1000, Global/Single-region. First 10,000 Class A per month free.

get_per_1000.note: Class B requests (includes GetObject, HeadObject) USD 0.0005/1000, Global/Single-region. First 100,000 Class B per month free.

list_per_1000.note: ListObjects/ListObjectsV2 are Class A: USD 0.005/1000, Global/Single-region.

typical_delay.note: Not stated; Standard objects are directly readable.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Minimum storage retention: N/A for Standard (the FAQ says the minimum charge applies only to Infrequent Access, Archive and Archive Instant Retrieval).

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Not stated on the pricing page or storage tiers doc.

notes: S3 storage class STANDARD. First 5 GB of Standard storage per month free.

price.note: Infrequent Access: USD 0.01/GB/month for Global and Single-region buckets ('Tigris pricing is the same across all geographies'). Tigris measures storage in binary GB (2^30 bytes).

put_per_1000.note: Class A requests (includes PutObject, CopyObject, CreateMultipartUpload) USD 0.005/1000, Global/Single-region. First 10,000 Class A per month free.

get_per_1000.note: Class B requests (includes GetObject, HeadObject) USD 0.0005/1000, Global/Single-region. First 100,000 Class B per month free.

list_per_1000.note: ListObjects/ListObjectsV2 are Class A: USD 0.005/1000, Global/Single-region.

typical_delay.note: Not stated; the tiers doc describes rapid access.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Minimum storage retention 30 days; objects deleted, updated or transitioned earlier are still charged 30 days.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Not stated on the pricing page or storage tiers doc.

storage_classes.name: Archive

price.note: Archive: USD 0.004/GB/month for Global and Single-region buckets ('Tigris pricing is the same across all geographies'). Tigris measures storage in binary GB (2^30 bytes).

put_per_1000.note: Class A requests (includes PutObject, CopyObject, CreateMultipartUpload) USD 0.005/1000, Global/Single-region. First 10,000 Class A per month free.

get_per_1000.note: Class B requests (includes GetObject, HeadObject) USD 0.0005/1000, Global/Single-region. First 100,000 Class B per month free.

list_per_1000.note: ListObjects/ListObjectsV2 are Class A: USD 0.005/1000, Global/Single-region.

price_per_gb.note: Data retrieval: Free. A restore moves the data to the Standard tier for the chosen number of days, billed at the Standard storage price meanwhile.

typical_delay.value: typically around 1 hour (restore required before reading)

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Not stated on the pricing page or storage tiers doc.

notes: S3 storage class GLACIER. GET returns 403 InvalidObjectState until restored.

price.note: Archive Instant Retrieval: USD 0.004/GB/month for Global and Single-region buckets ('Tigris pricing is the same across all geographies'). Tigris measures storage in binary GB (2^30 bytes).

put_per_1000.note: Class A requests (includes PutObject, CopyObject, CreateMultipartUpload) USD 0.005/1000, Global/Single-region. First 10,000 Class A per month free.

get_per_1000.note: Class B requests (includes GetObject, HeadObject) USD 0.0005/1000, Global/Single-region. First 100,000 Class B per month free.

list_per_1000.note: ListObjects/ListObjectsV2 are Class A: USD 0.005/1000, Global/Single-region.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Not stated on the pricing page or storage tiers doc.

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: No allowance is needed: egress is free for all tiers and location types.

price.note: 'Tigris does not charge for regional data transfer, region-to-region data transfer, or data transfer out to the internet (egress).'

notes: DELETE and CANCEL requests are free; failed requests with the listed error codes are not charged.

egress_fair_use.note: No fair-use limit is stated; the pricing page only says to contact help@tigrisdata.com for extraordinary bandwidth requirements.

free_tier.value: Every month: 5 GB Standard storage, 10,000 Class A requests (PUT, COPY, POST, LIST) and 100,000 Class B requests (GET, SELECT and others); no card needed to start.

object_lock.note: No Object Lock feature page found. The pricing page classifies PutObjectLockConfiguration, PutObjectRetention and PutObjectLegalHold as Class A requests and the IAM docs list them as actions, but the S3 compatibility matrix (https://www.tigrisdata.com/docs/api/s3/) does not test Object Lock.

s3_endpoints.label: Global
s3_endpoints.note: Single endpoint for all regions; set region to auto (https://www.tigrisdata.com/docs/concepts/regions/). The SDK guide configures boto3 with addressing_style 'virtual'.

notes: Prices are for Global (default) and Single-region buckets, which are identical. Multi-region: Standard USD 0.025, Infrequent Access 0.015, Archive and Archive IR 0.006 per GB-month, Class A USD 0.01/1000. Dual-region: storage and Class A billed per underlying region (pricing.md).
Object notifications cost USD 0.01 per 1000 events.
The older endpoint fly.storage.tigris.dev is not listed in the current regions doc and is left out.
